title: Coupon Prices
statement: A shop lists item prices in order. Each item gets a discount equal to the price of the first item after it that costs the same or less; if there is none, no discount. Return what each item finally costs.

answerKey.pattern: Monotonic stack: next smaller or equal to the right
keyPoints: Keep a stack of indexes waiting for a discount
While the current price is <= the price on top, apply it as that item's discount and pop
Push the current index; items left get no discount
acceptableSlowerApproaches: For each item, scan right for the first cheaper or equal price: O(n²)

hints: Each item waits for the first later price that is the same or lower. Which structure holds the waiting items?
A stack of indexes whose prices increase from bottom to top.
When a price arrives that is <= the top's price, subtract it from the top's price and pop; repeat, then push.
